text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those burning, scorching suns blazing in 
the sky—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They say the higher the temperature— the 
faster it burns out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. ~ Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe ~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The prestige is immense, and the hurdle 
just as high—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe crosses the finish line 
now. In an astonishing 13th place...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Her gait looks a bit off too. It seemed 
like her running got awkward halfway 
through... Is she going to be all right?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I will go on... a break. For a very, 
very long time...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
My "friend" was confused by the unfamiliar 
course as well. And my left leg got caught 
in the turf...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Cafe... You gotta be kidding me... Don't 
tell me you're in on this too...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
There is still hope... And yet... even 
so...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, is our generation cursed or 
something? Are we haunted by some bad 
omen!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That shouldn't be possible. Though, if I 
had to guess..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "Too intense... Her running, that is?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe was chasing after 
something. Just like Agnes Tachyon, she 
possessed an obsession bordering on 
delusion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you push yourself intensely on 
unfamiliar European courses as if driven 
by something, it's entirely possible you 
could injure your legs.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I see, it's about spirit, huh. When it 
comes to sheer passion, I won't lose 
either. But—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who'll never go down. My legs 
will never cry uncle!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAAAAGH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In truth, Jungle Pocket's tendons were 
extraordinarily sturdy. Thick, supple, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With this, there's nothing to worry about. 
Nothing at all...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ouch...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't worry about it. It's just a 
blood blister, a blood blister.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"My footstrike is insanely powerful, 
right? That's why I get blood blisters on 
my toes."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've gotten faster, it happens 
even more than before. Don't worry about 
it. I'm used to it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Deryaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tch! Gently, partner. I told you to do it 
more gently.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking care of her hurt toe. She does seem 
used to it, to be sure. But...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Uuuu...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Dammit. Lately, my recovery just can't 
keep up.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Why? How come? Is my body getting 
weaker...?
choice_data_list: No, it might be the other way around...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Jungle Pocket's body has grown stronger. 
Far stronger than before. That is 
precisely why――"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her push-off power grew dramatically, 
which only deepened the injury, making it 
impossible for her recovery to keep up. 
That was the only logical conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Wh... So on the flip side... her strength 
is actually backfiring on her...!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
How can things be this unfair... How is 
this possible...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I gotta get way, way stronger! And 
yet...!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: So, how is it, Trainer? —How are my legs?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I don't like it, but turnin' a blind eye 
to reality won't help. For now... is it 
gonna hold?
choice_data_list: Ah... I think it'll hold out.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I see. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Meaning you can't guarantee what comes 
after that?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, it's looking like it'll get tougher 
and tougher...

Yeah, looks like it's going to get tougher 
and tougher...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I see. The harder I run with all my might, 
the more it grinds me down...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
A war of attrition—without end, is it? 
From here on out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Devising a plan alone. I have to find a 
way to protect my toes somehow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After considering every possible 
method—taping, recovery enhancement 
techniques, adjusting race intervals—the 
answer we reached was...
choice_data_list:
I'll have to... change my training 
methods!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pushing off hard repeatedly on flat ground 
puts that much more strain on the hooves. 
To avoid that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Take uphill training, for example. If the 
course tilts backward, it should reduce 
the strain on the hooves, but...
choice_data_list:
No good, I can't get the fine-tuning right 
at all...

No good, I can't get the fine adjustments 
to work at all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The incline of the uphill track cannot be 
adjusted, so fine-tuning is impossible. 
This is insufficient...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that case, we have no choice but to 
renovate the facilities somehow, but...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I understand how you feel, but a 
massive renovation like that is impossible 
right away.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
We'd need both a budget and preparation, 
so doing it right this second is a bit...
choice_data_list: I see. Yes, that makes sense...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I brought it up just in case, but it's 
clearly too difficult. I'll just have to 
handle it myself...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It's impossible here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Here, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even searching around the freestyle 
racecourses, no viable substitute 
facilities could be found.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's tough after all... Even if I have an 
image of 'a facility like this,' finding a 
place that matches it exactly is...

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Um... did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm Pokke-san's underling, but... Um, what 
are you looking for...?

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... That sounds pretty bad... I 
wonder if Pokke-san will be okay.

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Being a Trainer sounds tough. Having to go 
out of your way to scout good training 
grounds and all.

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't know anything about the kind 
of facility you just described. But...

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I might have an idea. Could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: If it's that person in Hokkaido...
